input_files.runtime_observation: Current unitycli JSON envelopes and connected-instance descriptors

output_contract.normal_task_response: No additional fixed format is imposed.
output_contract.feedback_summary_condition: Either FeedbackMode is on and a real friction event occurred, or the user explicitly asked for a record in the current request; in both cases the recorder returned ok:true.
output_contract.no_friction_behavior: No feedback record and no feedback summary.

rollback_boundary.skill_install: The installer retains one fixed previous projection until the new runtime bundle passes filesystem readback.
rollback_boundary.feedback_mode: Bundle updates preserve the installed legal FeedbackMode value.
rollback_boundary.feedback_records: Append-only records inside the installed Skill experience directory are not automatically rolled back; retention is bounded by one main file and three archives, and a Skill update keeps that directory.
rollback_boundary.caller_authority: Timeout and retry decisions remain with the caller; governance metadata does not add an execution gate.

subprocess: powershell.exe for scripts/record-feedback.ps1 when FeedbackMode is on with friction, or when the user explicitly asked for a record in the current request
